import json,time
d=json.load(open('products/services/freelancer-decision/raw/api-sample.json'))
r=d.get('result',{})
ps=r.get('projects',[])
print('total',r.get('total_count'),'n',len(ps))
now=time.time()
for p in ps:
  age=(now-p.get('time_submitted',0))/3600
  b=p.get('budget',{});bc=(p.get('bid_stats') or {}).get('bid_count')
  print(p['id'],round(age,1),'h bids',bc,b.get('minimum'),b.get('maximum'),p.get('currency',{}).get('code'),'|',p.get('title')[:70],'|',(p.get('preview_description') or p.get('description') or '')[:160].replace('\n',' '))
